peg.peg_mechanism_score_basis: MEASURES THE REDEMPTION MECHANISM, NOT THE MARKET PRICE. An RWA-collateralised synthetic with NO ATOMIC ON-CHAIN REDEMPTION — the peg relies on opaque off-chain USDC settlement plus secondary liquidity. ⚠️ What an earlier revision treated as a temporary intraweek break has HARDENED into a standing discount, so this is scored as a structural feature rather than an excursion. A live price near par would not restore the missing redemption path.
peg.peg_mechanism_score_persistence: filtered — redemption mechanism, not market price

backing.backing_score_basis: MEASURES ATTESTED COVERAGE AND ITS SCOPE. Attested collateralisation has run SUB-100% since the June 2026 drawdown. ⚠️ The attested ratio is NETTED of protocol-owned liquidity and inventory on both sides — it is not reserves over supply — and only the SECURITIES leg is CPA-examined, leaving roughly 43.6% of the reserve outside that scope. Neither disclosure layer attests liabilities, so no opinion exists on coverage at all.
backing.backing_score_persistence: filtered — attested coverage on a netted basis, scope-limited

liquidity.liquidity_score_basis: MEASURES EXECUTABLE EXIT, and the figure it replaced was an artifact. A prior derivation quoted slippage on a PAR basis while the asset traded at a discount, triple-counting depth; the corrected basis is what this scores. ⚠️ Exit is further constrained by a cooldown into a terminal asset that is itself sub-par, so the realisable exit is worse than a spot quote implies.
liquidity.liquidity_score_persistence: filtered — executable exit including cooldown, not spot slippage
